author: Sleevedagger
quote: Starfield is a good game depending on what you was expecting. If you like addictive looter shooter type games with RPG and exploring elements then you will like it.  But if you were expecting an immersive space sim then this is not it. Not bad at all just not great either.

author: Sleevedagger
quote:
Atomic Heart captures the spirit of the old school corridor shooter but with modern graphical prowess.  It takes heavily from other gaming ideas but incorporates them in a a very unique and twisted world. Fun to explore, good combat and plenty to unlock and upgrade. You will have to develop your skills and master them to survive. The characters are tongue and cheek and intentionally brash reminding me of the underappreciated classic Bullet Storm. The plot is good and kept me interested throughout but don't expect some deep narrative surrounding the fictional alternative USSR backdrop. The story is more BioShock meets Skynet with a sprinkle of Half-Life.

As far as I'm concerned Atomic Heart is a breath of fresh air from all the "war simulators" and open world humdrum oversaturating the gaming industry.  We need more games like this.

author: Sleevedagger
quote: Cyberpunk 2077 is a fantastic immersive experience and a must buy for RPG players.  The game needs patches to iron out some of the bugs but there is nothing game breaking from my play through. Congratulations to CD project Red very impressive.

author: Sleevedagger
quote: Ghost of Tsushima feels perhaps a little too ambitious for the PS4 and often feels like it wanted to be more but current gen limitations keeping it from doing so. I imagine a PS5 or PC version would make this game legendary.  Very beautiful game, well told story and fun combat kept me hooked regardless. I highly recommend Ghost of Tsushima.

author: Sleevedagger
quote: Enjoyable shooter, fast and fluid controls. Nice graphics and style with a mix of different side activities to choose from and a good skill tree.  Story wise nothing special unfortunately  but game play is solid and addictive.  The world could of done with more interesting exploration considering its size.  It doesn't break any new grounds in the shooter category but does a lot of older ideas well.
